questions.stem: What is the default anaesthetic set-up for elderly patients?
questions.answer: BIS, low-dose propofol, consider 5 lead ECG

questions.stem: Which three cardiovascular conditions are common in elderly patients having surgery?
questions.answer: Ischaemic heart disease, heart failure and arrhythmias

questions.stem: What respiratory problem is common in elderly patients under anaesthesia?
Which two neurological problems are common in elderly surgical patients?
Which two airway features are common problems in elderly patients?
questions.answer: Limited neck extension and poor dentition

questions.stem: Which sedative premedications should be avoided in elderly patients?
questions.answer: Benzodiazepines, centrally acting anticholinergics and pethidine

questions.stem: Which two tests help separate dementia from acute confusion in elderly patients?
questions.answer: Abbreviated mental test or mini mental state examination

questions.stem: What dental problem is often found in elderly patients before surgery?

questions.stem: What exercise measure is a good guide to cardiorespiratory fitness in elderly patients?

What two steps should be considered when giving NSAIDs to elderly patients?
questions.answer: Use a COX-2 selective drug or add gastroprotection

questions.stem: What level of postoperative care is ideal for elderly patients after major surgery?
Which four parameters should be monitored and corrected after surgery in elderly patients?
questions.answer: Fluid balance, vital signs, electrolytes and haematology

questions.stem: What haemoglobin may elderly patients with cardiovascular disease need after surgery?
What reversible causes should be checked for postoperative confusion in elderly patients?
questions.answer: Pain, hypoxaemia, full bladder, myocardial or cerebral ischaemia, electrolyte disturbance and drugs
